purpose: User-requested small real-S10 execution smoke after bounded same-runtime preflight; not a scientific fit or Layer-9 merge
source: Exact clean generating commit supplied to smoke.sbatch and frozen in runtime software contract
selection: Eight evenly spaced ordered row indices within each of three cell-type blocks; no outcome-based selection
gpinit: First two factor columns/rows of registered full-data S10 v2 GPINIT run 1; eta restricted to selected cells; no refit or recentering
mesh: Preserve full mesh, FEM terms and coordinate frame; select projector rows and their active support; retain all 371 modes
preflight: Two authenticated original/port Layer-4 comparisons and exact chart-contract rounding-boundary probe; abort smoke on failure
restart: Pause after sweep 1; new process restores genesis and commits sweep 2; third process verifies completed non-replay with sweep forbidden
data_scope: Authenticated full-data artifacts already transferred; never open raw H5AD or response HDF5
failure_policy: Retain partial outputs; timeout is incomplete; no automatic larger retry or parameter/tolerance change
